recommended_actions:
Review the dispatch system the following business day after attestation/upload.
Search dispatch history using Job Filter > All Comments > “CANCELLED BY MAS”.
Identify affected trips marked as CANCELLED.
Search the member/trip record to determine whether MAS cancelled one leg or both legs.
Confirm trip status using:
GPS route/activity
member signature/receipt
cancellation timestamp
pickup and drop-off times
Determine whether cancellation occurred:
before pickup
after pickup but before drop-off
after drop-off / after trip completion
Access the MAS portal and search the invoice under Manage Trips > Search Trip by Invoice.
Check whether Correction Request is available in the MAS portal.
If Correction Request is available, submit the correction directly through the MAS portal.
If Correction Request is not available, email the correction request to tripinvresolution@medanswering.com
 with all required evidence attached.
Document the request method used, date submitted, and whether the case is pending MAS response.
Do not rebill from a replacement live trip unless the replacement record contains complete GPS and signature data required for billing.
Ensure the correction request is submitted within the 30-day deadline.
guidance: Staff must determine whether MAS cancelled the trip before pickup, after pickup, or after drop-off, and whether one leg or both legs were affected. Before requesting any correction, staff must confirm trip completion using dispatch history, GPS, member signature, and cancellation timing. If MAS cancelled after the trip was completed, the case may qualify for correction or reinstatement. If MAS cancelled before service was performed, the case is not supportable and should not be disputed.

name: Invoice Number not in System
description: This error occurs when an invoice that was previously tied to a completed trip is no longer available for attestation because MAS cancelled the trip after the driver had already completed service. It is typically identified the day after trips were uploaded and reviewed in the dispatch system. In some cases, MAS may issue a replacement invoice, but this depends on when the cancellation occurred and whether the trip or leg was actually completed before cancellation.
